en.summary: The probability of a US recession remains at 36%, driven by mixed economic signals and rising national debt concerns. Recent comments from Jerome Powell highlight fiscal challenges while stock markets show resilience.
drivers: Jerome Powell's warning on national debt trajectory
Stock market recovery despite economic uncertainties
Inflation concerns linked to rising energy prices
en.why_matters: Understanding recession probabilities helps investors and policymakers prepare for potential economic downturns, influencing financial decisions.
en.bull_case: If inflation stabilizes and growth continues, recession fears could diminish, raising probabilities.
en.bear_case: Escalating debt and inflation could trigger tighter monetary policy, increasing recession risks.

zh.title: 评估2026年的衰退风险
zh.summary: 美国衰退概率保持在36%，受经济信号混杂和国债担忧驱动。杰罗姆·鲍威尔的最新评论突显财政挑战，而股市显示出韧性。
drivers: 鲍威尔对国债走势的警告
尽管经济不确定，股市复苏
与能源价格上涨相关的通胀担忧
zh.why_matters: 理解衰退概率有助于投资者和政策制定者为潜在经济下滑做好准备，影响金融决策。
zh.bull_case: 如果通胀稳定且经济持续增长，衰退担忧可能减弱，概率上升。
zh.bear_case: 债务和通胀上升可能引发更紧的货币政策，增加衰退风险。
